recognize_zh: 兩個 40 倍血液抹片視野（A、B）中，紅血球間散布許多小型碎片、盔形及三角形的破碎紅血球（schistocytes），部分為棘狀皺縮細胞，血小板仍可見；這種碎裂紅血球是機械性溶血的判讀重點。
features: Composite of two low-power peripheral blood fields (A, B)
Scattered schistocytes including small irregular fragments, helmet cells and triangular forms
Occasional crenated/echinocytic red cells and mild anisopoikilocytosis
Platelets present in small clumps, not markedly reduced in these fields
Leukocytes include segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes and a larger mononuclear cell; no blasts
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power (two fields) shows mild to moderate anisopoikilocytosis with scattered schistocytes, including small irregular fragments, helmet cells and triangular forms, as well as occasional crenated red cells. Platelets are present and appear adequate in these fields, and the leukocytes are morphologically unremarkable. At this magnification a schistocyte percentage should be estimated on high power before reporting. Findings are consistent with fragmentation hemolysis, compatible with mechanical hemolytic anemia in the appropriate clinical setting such as a prosthetic or diseased heart valve.

ddx.vs: Shows similar schistocytes but with marked thrombocytopenia, whereas platelets appear preserved here; ADAMTS13 activity and renal function help separate them.
Schistocytes are accompanied by thrombocytopenia and prolonged PT/aPTT with low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer.
Artifactual crenated cells are evenly spiculated and uniform in size, lacking the sharp-cornered fragments and helmet cells of true schistocytes.
Show micropoikilocytes and budding fragments with microspherocytes, related to red cell membrane defects or thermal injury rather than a valve.
